standard-dialogue.npc: You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.

standard-dialogue.player: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!

standard-dialogue.npc: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.

standard-dialogue.player: Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?

standard-dialogue.npc: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.

standard-dialogue.text: The costumer gives you one of her special needles.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-co.npc: Have you still got that needle safe and secure?
